messages:
Maya: seeing a gap in usage logs for eu-west between 2026-08-14T02:00 and 2026-08-14T05:30, forecast inputs missing. anyone on the ingest side?
Theo: looks like the kafka-connect connector to eu-west s3 failed, logs show connection resets and some 503s. small snippet:
```
ERROR kafka.connect: failed to upload segment: connection reset by peer
upload_attempts=3
```
Theo: the connector auto-retries but offsets moved forward; we have partial-day data only.
ops-bot: [ALERT] pipeline:forecast-ingest failed 1789954400 - 503 from s3-eu-west endpoint :warning:
Jamie: missing ~3.5 hours of metrics will bias the weekly GPU-hour forecast down ~5-8% depending on smoothing. we should backfill before retraining.
Kevin: there was a maintenance window on the eu-west peering cluster at 02:15-02:45, not marked in infra calendar — I'll follow up with networking.
Maya: propose plan:
1) stop realtime aggregators (prevent double-counting during replay)
2) replay kafka topic from offset X (where connector last committed)
3) run dedupe job on raw_events parquet table
4) run hourly rollup backfill to materialized_metrics
5) annotate dashboards + retrain forecast models after backfill
Maya: sample kafka replay command (run on data-eng jumpbox):
```
kafka-console-consumer --bootstrap-server kafka.prod:9092 \
  --topic usage-events-eu-west --from-beginning --consumer-property auto.offset.reset=earliest \
  --max-messages 500000 | gzip > /tmp/eu_gap_20260814.gz
```
Theo: for detection of missing windows use this SQL against raw_events:
```
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) as hr, count(*) FROM raw_events
WHERE region = 'eu-west' AND ts >= '2026-08-14' AND ts < '2026-08-15'
GROUP BY hr ORDER BY hr;
```
Theo: I'll run the replay and send the gz to the processing cluster. planning to keep it staged in /data/backfills/eu/20260814
Kevin: when replaying, please use the ingest-side rate limiter to avoid overload on postgres/warehouse. set batch_size=1000 and concurrency=4.
Jamie: after backfill I'll run a quick impact check: compare last model inputs pre/post backfill and run the sanity eval on the holdout prompt set. if delta > 3% we do a retrain + deploy.
Maya: who can run the dedupe -> rollup job? Jamie or Theo?
Theo: I can kick the dedupe and rollup once the file is staged. ETA 45-60m after replay finishes.
Kevin: I'll add a temporary buffer to the Dedicated GPU pool for eu-west (increase by 200 GPU-hours/day) to cover any unexpected load if forecast bumps up.
Jamie: heads up to product & support — tagging @product for customer-facing note? we might want to add a dashboard annotation and a small status blurb.
Maya: +1 for annotation. I'll add it to the forecasting dashboard and to the internal incident notes.
ops-bot: [TASK CREATED] backfill-eu-20260814 assigned to Theo - due 1789957600
Theo: starting replay now. will post progress every 15m. :eyes:
Maya: thanks — please paste the dedupe SQL here when ready so we can review before running.
Theo: dedupe pattern (will use staged table):
```
CREATE TABLE staged AS
SELECT DISTINCT ON (event_id) * FROM raw_events_staged
ORDER BY event_id, ts DESC;
-- then insert into raw_events
```
Jamie: quick check: make sure we keep original partitioning by hour for rollup job to be efficient.
Kevin: noted. also opening a ticket for networking to add maintenance to calendar and confirm peering SLA.
Maya: wrapping up: timeline estimate — replay + dedupe + rollup ~2.5-3h, then sanity eval ~30m. will update slack when forecast model retrain decision is made. :shipit:
